entities.name: Query UbiE protein
observations: 248 aa soluble, strongly basic protein; predicted molecular weight 28.98 kDa and pI 9.40.
Contains a highly significant UbiE methyltransferase domain, Pfam Ubie_methyltran PF01209.25 spanning residues 19–247 (i-Evalue 2.2e-58).
Shares 42.1–43.0% identity over 91.5% query coverage with reviewed UbiE homologs from Geobacter-related bacteria.
Likely catalyzes SAM-dependent C-methylation in quinone biosynthesis; exact substrate branch is inferred from homologs rather than experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: UbiE
observations: Reviewed homologs are ubiquinone/menaquinone biosynthesis C-methyltransferases.

Annotated reactions include conversion of demethylmenaquinol to menaquinol and methylation of a methoxy polyprenyl benzoquinol intermediate, using S-adenosyl-L-methionine and producing S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Associated with EC 2.1.1.163 and EC 2.1.1.201 and GO biological process term GO:0009234, menaquinone biosynthetic process.
